title: Joint calibration of the volatility surface and variance term structure
abstract: arXiv:2509.08096v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: I study the calibration of option pricing models with an objective that combines errors on the implied volatility surface and on the variance term structure (VTS), and how the weight on the two trades one fit against the other. I then ask how the calibration affects hedges built from the fitted model. The setting is the stochastic volatility jump-diffusion model of Bates (1996), calibrated to S&P 500 index options on each trading day from 1996 to 2025. Calibrated to option prices alone, the model misses the VTS; however, a small weight on the VTS sharply reduces the error at the cost of a small loss in accuracy on the volatility surface and little change in hedging performance. I fit the model in two ways: unrestricted, with every parameter free, and restricted, with the spot variance pinned to an estimate from high-frequency returns and one jump-size law for all dates, estimated from option prices pooled across dates. translated_title: 波动率曲面与方差期限结构的联合校准
translated_abstract: 我研究了期权定价模型的校准问题，其目标函数同时结合了隐含波动率曲面与方差期限结构（VTS）上的误差，并探讨两者之间的权重权衡如何影响拟合效果。随后我考察这种校准方式如何影响基于拟合模型构建的对冲策略。研究设定采用Bates（1996）的随机波动率跳跃扩散模型，对1996年至2025年间每个交易日的标普500指数期权进行校准。若仅以期权价格进行校准，模型无法拟合方差期限结构；然而，只需对方差期限结构赋予较小的权重，就能大幅降低其拟合误差，代价仅是波动率曲面精度略有下降，而对冲性能几乎没有变化。我以两种方式拟合模型：无约束方式（所有参数均自由）和有约束方式（即期方差固定为来自高频收益率的估计值，并对所有日期采用统一的跳跃幅度分布，由跨日期汇总的期权价格估计得出）。这一选择……
tldr: 本文提出在期权定价模型校准中联合拟合隐含波动率曲面与方差期限结构，并基于Bates模型对标普500期权近三十年的数据证明：对方差期限结构赋予较小权重即可大幅降低其拟合误差，而对波动率曲面精度和对冲性能影响甚微。
en_tdlr: This paper jointly calibrates the implied volatility surface and the variance term structure in a Bates (1996) stochastic volatility jump-diffusion model on S&P 500 options from 1996 to 2025, showing that a small weight on the variance term structure sharply reduces its fitting error at the cost of only slightly lower volatility surface accuracy and little change in hedging performance.
